sections.overview:
claud-skills is a comprehensive framework of 14 production-ready agents and 11 reusable skills designed for Claude Code automation. It provides battle-tested solutions for code quality (ESLint fixing), automated testing (Playwright, Pest), UI/UX design (mockup generation), and project management (changelog versioning). The framework delivers 61-99.8% token savings and 5-95x speed improvements through optimized prompts and direct API access. Auto-generated documentation ensures quick setup across JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, Laravel, React, and Python projects. It's built for developers seeking simple, high-impact productivity wins without complex configurations.
Fix ESLint issues with risk-based analysis and safer feature-scoped changes
Generate automated browser tests using Playwright from user interactions
Create HTML/CSS mockups with design system integration and theme support
Automate changelog updates and semantic version releases
- **Agents**: 13 specialized agents for various automation tasks
- **Skills**: 9 core skills for project management, code generation, and documentation
- **Languages Supported**: JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, Laravel, React, Python
- **Industry**: Healthcare IT
